purpose: Fail-closed manufacture and render-shell contract for the benchmark-close stainless slide chute. It replaces the earlier overlapping open sheet surfaces with one watertight thin-sheet U-section solid so grazing light cannot expose open longitudinal edges, coincident shell seams or non-manifold end gaps. This contract is implementation evidence only and awards no Visual Fidelity points without native rendered pixels.

referenceBasis.topic: park slide material and geometry envelope
requirementsUsed: sliding surface stainless steel plate thickness 1.5 mm or greater
side wall plate thickness 2.3 mm or greater when steel is used; stainless side-wall construction may use the stainless material route defined by the current city selection guidance
transition radius R750 mm or greater
final detailed shape remains a manufacturer approval-drawing matter
referenceBasis.historicalContext: The city standard-drawing lineage includes partial revisions in April 1999 and April 2002. Current published sheets are used only as construction-principle and dimensional-envelope references, not as evidence for one exact circa-2000 manufacturer product.

requirementsUsed: sliding surface SUS304 thickness 1.5 mm or greater
side faces may be SUS304 thickness 1.5 mm or greater
metal slide orientation should avoid excessive direct-sun heating/reflection where practicable

components: left and right 140 mm raised SUS304 side-wall sheet volumes
formed lower corner continuity between running sheet and side walls
physically closed head and runout sheet ends
existing coated-steel head bearer and runout bearer from the slide access/support contract
assemblySequence: form or weld the 2.0 mm SUS304 running sheet and side walls to the documented U-section net shape
finish/deburr exposed sheet edges; silhouette-scale sheet thickness remains geometry
seat the chute head onto the transverse coated-steel head bearer
seat the low runout onto the transverse runout bearer
retain fine directional use abrasion and fabrication grain in the material rather than painting lighting into albedo
manufactureReconstruction.mounting: Local +Z is the descending direction. The chute starts at the platform-side head near z=0.18 m and ends at the runout near z=4.38 m. The running sheet is carried by the explicit head/runout support path already generated by slide_access_installation_contract.json. This pass changes only the render shell; it adds no gameplay collider and does not move the gameplay slide anchors.
manufactureReconstruction.interfacesGapsSeals: The sheet solid must be topologically watertight: zero geometric boundary edges and zero non-manifold edges after position welding tolerance. The running sheet and side walls are one net fabricated solid rather than overlapping coplanar shells. Head and runout ends are physically capped. No decorative sealant, painted contact shadow or baked highlight is permitted.
manufactureReconstruction.orientation: Running surface follows a cubic Hermite y(z) path from the platform down to a nearly horizontal runout. The local sheet normal remains upward-facing along the run. Side walls rise approximately normal to the running surface; local X spans the chute width.
manufactureReconstruction.exposure: Running surface and side-wall tops receive direct summer sun, rain and repeated hand/foot/clothing contact. Underside and bearing interfaces are more sheltered. The current benchmark is dry; no global wet coating is allowed.
manufactureReconstruction.aging: Directional travel abrasion follows the descent direction. Water residue follows gravity/runoff and may collect near transitions only when causally supported. Stainless receives fine contamination and abrasion rather than paint chalking or arbitrary ferrous rust.
manufactureReconstruction.geometryVsMaterialDetail: 2.0 mm sheet thickness, 920 mm envelope width, 140 mm side-wall height, curved descent/runout silhouette and closed end faces are geometry. Brushed/fabrication grain, sub-millimetre scratches, fingerprints/handling variation and restrained residue are material/microdetail. Highlights and contact shadows must come from lighting/BRDF/geometry, never albedo paint.
manufactureReconstruction.lodPolicy: LOD0/1/2/3 use the same physical cross-section and curve envelope with 96/48/24/12 longitudinal segments. The vertex/triangle count may fall with distance, but sheet thickness, side-wall silhouette, head/runout positions and watertightness remain invariant. The existing HD_Slide LODGroup must retain animated cross-fade and must bind the corrected PhysicalChute renderer in each tier.

stainlessChute.specularF0_note: conductor response is controlled by the metallic workflow; do not force dielectric F0 onto stainless
stainlessChute.microstructure: fine fabrication grain plus directional use abrasion below silhouette scale
stainlessChute.wetness: dry benchmark default; only localized causal water may reduce apparent roughness
stainlessChute.uvAging: no paint chalking; restrained contamination and fine abrasion only
stainlessChute.angularResponse: grazing reflection must arise from the metallic BRDF, coherent sun/sky and reflection probes; no baked specular streaks

forbidden: overlapping separate running-sheet and side-wall shells used as the final chute
open longitudinal sheet edge visible from grazing or end-on framing
uncapped head or runout sheet volume
dielectric-looking stainless caused by materially impossible metallic values
floating chute away from its documented bearing interfaces
LOD level reverting to a thick box or open legacy shell
criticalDefectsProtected: visible primitive-placeholder geometry in benchmark framing

requiredViews: cross-section showing 920 mm width, 2.0 mm sheet solid and 140 mm side walls
side elevation showing head/runout positions and minimum R750 transition requirement
end detail showing a physically capped sheet volume rather than an open shell
lookdev.note: Construction lookdev only. It is not rendered Visual Fidelity evidence.

requiredEvidence: native 3840x2160 oblique benchmark frame containing the slide
100% construction-depth or slide crop proving no open/coplanar side-sheet seam and no daylight through the head/runout ends
100% grazing-light crop proving the 2 mm sheet edge reads as thin fabricated metal rather than a thick box and the stainless response is environment-driven
temporal evidence through all four slide LOD transitions proving the chute silhouette/thickness does not pop or shimmer
renderVerification.scoringPolicy: Source topology, dimensions and contract compliance award zero Visual Fidelity points. Only sealed native rendered evidence may earn Geometry, Material, Lighting or Temporal credit or clear a critical defect.
